examples.arabic: كنت مبسوطة اوي لغاية ما سألت صاحبتي انتي شوفتي هدير اللي قاعدة جنبنا
examples.english: I was so happy until I asked my friend: 'Did you see Hadeer who was sitting next to us?'
examples.transliteration: kont mabsouta awi leghayet ma sa'alt sahabty: 'inti shofti Hadeer elli qa3da gambena?'

examples.arabic: سألت راجل عجوز قالي امشي طوالي لغاية ما تلاقي كوبري ابو العلا وبعدين يمين
examples.english: I asked an old man, he told me to walk straight until you find the Abu El Ela bridge, then turn right.
examples.transliteration: Sa'alt ragel 3agooz, qali emshi tawali leghayet ma tla'i kobri Abu El Ela we ba3den yemeen.
